text: It cannot fly. It has never needed to.
The ostrich — the largest of all living birds. Two metres eighty tall, and up to one hundred and fifty-six kilograms.
It is the fastest animal on two legs. Seventy kilometres an hour,
on strides three metres long — each foot carrying just two toes.
And the eye, five centimetres across, is larger than the brain it serves.
The largest egg on Earth: one and a half kilograms —
two dozen hen's eggs in the hand. The male keeps it warm through the African night.
It cannot fly. It never needed to.
